audit.whatIsWrong: Chart read Skill, Shen, Shen, Skill, Skill, Shen, Shen while the page's own whys say Kled owns levels 2, 3 and 6 and that level 1 is Shen's.
audit.why: Kled has no Bear Trap on a Rope at level 1, so Shen's Q-empowered autos own that row; the trap plus Violent Tendencies owns 2-3; Chaaaaaaaarge!!! owns 6.
audit.corrected: Rows set to Shen, Kled, Kled, Skill, Kled, Shen, Shen in both layers as one atomic paired group, matching the packet and the mirror record.

audit.why: The four spikes (2-3 trap, 4-5 dismount window, 6 Chaaaaaaaarge!!!, first item attrition) match the corrected chart and the level text; only the level-6 phase why needed to stop implying the row was neutral.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why rewritten to state the R lock-on and shield and to hold Stand United for an ally.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[1].why and dosFull[2].d implied Spirit's Refuge answers Bear Trap on a Rope. It blocks attacks only, so the trap and its yank pass straight through. dosFull[0].d, dontsFull[0].d, dontsFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d all carried filler unrelated to their titles, and no real cooldowns appeared.
audit.why: Standing in the W expecting the hook to be blocked is exactly how the yank-into-Violent-Tendencies burst kills you.
audit.corrected: The attacks-only rule now appears in phases[1].why, dosFull[2].d and dontsFull[0].d; Bear Trap on a Rope's 11s rank-1 cooldown is in phases[1].why, dosFull[0].d and tradeGood; Violent Tendencies is named as four fast attacks on 13s in dontsFull[2].d; dontsFull[1].d states that a full courage bar remounts Skaarl.

edits.before: W spirit zone blanks his auto window. Only take the trade when Kled's Bear Trap on a Rope is down.
edits.after: Bear Trap on a Rope (11s at rank 1) yanks you into his burst — Spirit's Refuge does not stop it.

edits.before: Stand United makes your lane a 1v2 for the enemy MAP — track every low ally. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Kled's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Chaaaaaaaarge!!! locks onto you and shields him — do not duel it in open lane; bank Stand United for a dying ally instead of a 50-50.

edits.before: Pull the blade through Kled, E-taunt when his answer is down, and weave the empowered autos — then shove and watch the map.
edits.after: Pull the blade through Kled, E-taunt once the bear trap is spent, and weave the empowered autos — then shove and watch the map.

edits.before: His engage hook. E-taunt after it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: His engage hook, 11s at rank 1 — step up only once the trap is spent.

edits.before: Kled wastes Bear Trap on a Rope — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Spirit's Refuge blocks his four Violent Tendencies attacks, not the Q.

edits.before: That is Kled's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Spirit's Refuge stops attacks, never the bear trap — the yank still lands.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Skaarl comes back at full courage — finish the dismounted Kled.

edits.before: Tunneling the 1v1 while your R could flip a dive bot — Shen who only plays his lane is half a champion.
edits.after: Violent Tendencies is four fast attacks on a 13s cooldown — step out of it and re-engage the moment it expires.

notes: UNVERIFIED, left as it stands: report[8].t and breakdown.late both call anti-heal core against Kled and refer to 'his healing'. Kled's kit has no heal — Skaarl returns via courage, and whether Grievous Wounds affects that restore is not answerable from the kit files, so no anti-heal text was changed or removed. Also carried from the mirror and not asserted anywhere on the page: whether Shadow Dash's taunt interrupts Kled's R charge mid-flight.
